name: Mortgage Affordability Calculator
description: Calculate maximum affordable home purchase price and loan amount based on income, monthly debts, down payment, and 28/36 DTI limits.
search_intent: Calculate how much house I can afford based on salary, down payment, and debts.
keywords: how much house can i afford

inputs.label: Monthly recurring debts (auto, student, credit cards)

calculation: Monthly gross income = annualGrossIncome / 12. Maximum allowed housing payment under front-end rule = monthlyIncome × (frontEndDti / 100). Maximum allowed total obligations under back-end rule = monthlyIncome × (backEndDti / 100). Maximum housing payment under back-end rule = max(0, allowedTotalObligations − monthlyDebts). Allowable monthly PITI = min(allowedFront, allowedBack). Monthly mortgage payment factor: f = i × (1 + i)^n / ((1 + i)^n − 1), where i = rate / 100 / 12, n = years × 12. Monthly insurance = annualInsurance / 12. Monthly tax rate factor t = taxRate / 100 / 12. Solve PITI equation: Price × (f + t) = AllowablePITI − MonthlyInsurance + (f × DownPayment). Price = max(downPaymentAmount, (AllowablePITI − MonthlyInsurance + (f × DownPayment)) / (f + t)). Maximum mortgage = max(0, Price − DownPayment).
limitations: Private mortgage insurance (PMI) is required by most conventional lenders when the down payment is under 20%.
HOA dues, closing costs, transfer taxes, and maintenance reserves are not included in the basic underwriting calculation.
Actual mortgage pre-approval requires verified credit scores, two years of tax returns, and debt underwriting.
